name: gitpod-egress-proxy
description: Run an HTTP/HTTPS forward proxy on this machine so a Gitpod/Ona workspace can reach the internet through it.

gitpodProxy.host.markdownDescription: Address to bind. Keep `127.0.0.1` and reach the proxy through an SSH reverse tunnel. Binding a LAN address exposes the proxy to your whole network and requires a username and password.

gitpodProxy.port.description: Port to listen on. Use 0 to let the operating system choose a free port.

gitpodProxy.username.markdownDescription: Username for Basic proxy authentication. Leave empty to run without authentication. The password is stored separately via the **Gitpod Proxy: Set Proxy Password** command, not in settings.

gitpodProxy.allowPrivateNetworks.description: Permit the workspace to reach private, loopback, and link-local addresses on this machine and its LAN. Off by default.

gitpodProxy.allowHosts.markdownDescription: If non-empty, only these destination hosts are reachable. `*.example.com` matches the domain and its subdomains.

gitpodProxy.denyHosts.markdownDescription: Destination hosts to always refuse. Checked before the allowlist. `*.example.com` matches the domain and its subdomains.

gitpodProxy.allowPorts.description: If non-empty, only these destination ports are reachable. Empty permits any port.

gitpodProxy.logLevel.description: Verbosity of the proxy's output channel.

gitpodProxy.autoStart.description: Start the proxy automatically when this window finishes loading.

gitpodProxy.sshTarget.markdownDescription: Workspace SSH target used in the generated tunnel command, for example `user@workspace.ssh.gitpod.io`.

gitpodProxy.inspector.captureBodies.description: Capture request and response bodies so the inspector can show them. Turn off to record only headers, status, and timing.

gitpodProxy.inspector.maxBodyBytes.description: Largest amount of any single body to keep in memory. Bodies beyond this are shown truncated.

gitpodProxy.inspector.maxTransactions.description: How many recent transactions to keep. Older ones are dropped as new traffic arrives.

gitpodProxy.allowUnauthenticatedRemote.description: Permit binding a non-loopback address without a username and password. Leave off unless you understand the exposure.
